description: An edit proposed to a page of a notebook, kept by the notebook's host (edits.json, beside records.json) until the user accepts or rejects it in Record.

old.description: What it replaces (empty: it adds at the page's end).

start.description: Where what it replaces starts in the page's text.

status.description: pending: waiting for the user; accepted, rejected; withdrawn: taken back.

t.description: When it was proposed, in seconds since the epoch.

by.description: Who proposed it, or revised it last: Meta, an agent's own name.

gone.description: (edits) What it replaces isn't on the page as it was any more.
